policy_themes_for_diagnostics_only: Fast Urza is not sufficient when post-Urza mana collapses.
Mana plus interaction without a value or win plan can still be a mulligan.
Colored and persistent mana quality matters separately from nominal mana quantity.
Interaction does not rescue every otherwise weak hand.
Plausible T4 conversion matters for several seven-card decisions.
Keep threshold changes with mulligan stage and retained-card count.
